title: 017 大量功德018 功勋荣授
content_zh:
神异司，休息室内。
许临东仔细检查了一遍身上的灼伤，确认伤势已经彻底痊愈，算是彻底见识了人道序列的治疗能力。
“通天塔在手，我也可以兼修多条序列路径。
以后要是能弄到人道序列的超凡物质，说不定也能掌握这样的治疗手段。”
心念转动间，他走进浴室冲洗了一番。
换了身干净衣服坐到床边，意识迅速沉入通天塔内。
空旷的通天塔大厅中，许临东径直走向中央，抬头望向那面约两米高的椭圆形镜面。
镜面如水波般荡开。
一行行如日志般的金色字迹飞快浮现。
【最新关押记录
收纳“鬼吏怨念诅咒”
（源头：地道序列七·鬼吏邪异物残留）
状态：诅咒已镇压炼化中。
收获：功德60】
“原来青龙寺护法堂里被门神帖封着的……竟是序列七的【鬼吏】级邪异物，怪不得那么凶恶强大……”
看到第一行信息，许临东顿时明白了青龙寺内那件邪物的可怕层次。
当时他站在院中，暗中催动通天塔，吸纳了少许从门缝渗出的诅咒气息。
只是那时，他也没及时入塔查看。
现在想来，幸好那东西最终没能破封而出，否则后果将会不堪设想。
他继续朝下看日志讯息。

“收纳“游魂鬼爪”
（源头：地道序列九·游魂）
状态：鬼爪已镇压炼化中。
关押消耗：功德25
收获：功德230”
“收纳“刮面直刀”
（源头：地道序列八·阴差级邪异物子器）
状态：子器已隔离镇压，邪异波动平复。
关押消耗：功德120
收获：功德650”
【最新邪异事态处理记录
协助组织鬼吏级邪异物脱困，成功关押阴差级邪异物子器，避免城市级低危事件诞生。
收获：功德300】
“没想到，这次处理邪异事件还给我增加了300功德，算是大丰收了。”
许临东有些惊喜，看向最后一行讯息。
【个人状态辅助记录
镇压体内灶神碳反噬，平衡序列冲突。
消耗：功德45
当前功德余额：1725】
“不错，即便不算上司里的功绩，单是通天塔的功德我就是赚大了，顶得上过去半年的收成。”

看着暴涨一千的功德数值，许临东心头一振。
这趟凶险，算是他穿越半年来最要命的一次。
可丰厚的功德，正应了那句话，富贵险中求。
功德对他而言是非常重要的。
content_en:
Department of Mysteries, in the lounge.
Xu Lindong carefully checked the burns on his body and confirmed that the injuries had been completely healed. This was a thorough experience of the healing power of the Humane Sequence.
“With the Tower of Babel in hand, I can also master multiple sequence paths.
In the future, if we can obtain extraordinary substances of the humane sequence, we might also be able to master such treatment methods. "
As his mind wandered, he walked into the bathroom and took a shower.
After changing into clean clothes and sitting on the edge of the bed, his consciousness quickly sank into the Tower of Babel.
In the empty Babel Hall, Xu Lindong walked straight to the center and looked up at the oval mirror about two meters high.
The mirror surface swayed like water waves.
Lines of golden writing like a log appeared quickly.
[Latest detention records
Contains "Ghost Officials' Curse of Resentment"
(Source: Tunnel Sequence Seven·Remains of Ghost Officials and Evil Foreign Objects)
Status: The curse has been suppressed and is being refined.
Harvest: Merit 60]
"It turns out that what was sealed by the Gate God in the Dharma Protector Hall of Qinglong Temple... was actually a Sequence Seven [Ghost Official] level evil object. No wonder it is so vicious and powerful..."
Seeing the first line of information, Xu Lindong immediately understood the terrifying level of the evil object in Qinglong Temple.
At that time, he stood in the courtyard, secretly activating the Tower of Babel, and absorbed a little bit of the curse breath seeping out from the cracks in the door.
But at that time, he didn't enter the tower in time to check.
Thinking about it now, it's fortunate that the thing didn't break out in the end, otherwise the consequences would be disastrous.
He continued to look down at the log messages.
"Storage "Wandering Ghost Claw"
(Source: Authentic Sequence 9·Wandering Soul)
Status: The ghost claw has been suppressed and refining.
Detention cost: Merit 25
Harvest: Merit 230"
"Storage "Shaving Straight Knife"
(Source: Authentic Sequence 8·Yindian-level evil foreign object weapon)
Status: The child device has been isolated and suppressed, and the evil fluctuations have calmed down.
Confinement cost: 120 merits
Harvest: Merit 650"
[The latest record of dealing with evil situations
Assisted in organizing the escape of ghost-level evil and foreign objects, successfully imprisoned Yin-level evil and foreign objects, and prevented the occurrence of city-level low-risk incidents.
Harvest: 300 merits]
"Unexpectedly, this time I dealt with the evil incident and gained 300 merits. It's a great harvest."
Xu Lindong was a little surprised and looked at the last line of message.
【Personal status auxiliary record
Suppresses Vesta carbon backphagy in the body and balances sequence conflicts.
Consumption: Merit 45
Current merit balance: 1725]
"That's right. Even if I don't count the merits from my superiors, I've made a lot of money just from the merits of Babel Tower, which can equal my harvest in the past six months."
Seeing the merit value that skyrocketed by one thousand, Xu Lindong's heart was lifted.
This dangerous trip can be regarded as the most dangerous one in the six months since he traveled through time.
But the abundant merits and virtues are exactly what the saying goes, wealth can be found in danger.
Merit is very important to him.
